script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The passage says what the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will be fulfilled. It does not say the whole trip to Jerusalem was written down.
Papa refers to the choice card, which breaks the rule against talking about the lesson itself.
The passage says the meaning was hidden, but it does not establish that hearing was not a problem.
The passage does not say whether a governor was in the crowd. It says the people told the man Jesus was passing by.
The passage does not say the crowd or commotion was about Jesus. It says a crowd was going by and that Jesus was passing by.
The explanation of Son of David as a title for the promised King goes beyond this passage and needs a supporting reference.
The passage says Jesus stopped, not that He stopped the whole walk.
Saying the crowd tried to quiet the man on its own adds a detail the passage does not give.
“Close on the calling” suggests Jesus called back to the man. The passage says He directed that the man be brought to Him.
The passage does not say the man had been crying out the whole time.
The passage says the man received his sight and followed Jesus, but it does not identify the first thing he did with his sight.
The passage does not establish that the people who told the man to be silent were among those who saw the healing and praised God.
